set -eu
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,collections
stats=collections.Counter()
for p in Path('apps/mobile/src').rglob('*.tsx'):
 if p.name.endswith(('.test.tsx','.spec.tsx')):continue
 s=p.read_text()
 for name in ['button','input','select','textarea']:
  stats[name]+=len(re.findall(r'<'+name+r'(?=[\s/>])',s))
print('NATIVE_MARKUP',dict(stats))
PY
echo 'BUNDLE_MANIFEST'
grep -R -n 'ion-icon' apps/mobile/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | head -50 || true
echo 'COMPACT_HOST_LOAD'
uptime
